_comment: Measured on this box (GTX 1650 4 GiB, i5-11300H). Rewrite by running the commands in the note; do not edit by hand.

_source.bandwidth_gb_s: GTX 1650: 6001 MHz max mem clock x2 (GDDR5) x128-bit / 8, as reported by NVML
_source.flops_tflops: GTX 1650 FP16: 1280 shader cores x 2 x 1.41 GHz boost / 1e6
_source.gateway_overhead_pct: make gate-gateway PORT=8000 CONCURRENCY=1 (median-3 of 3 runs)
_source.gateway_floor_pct: llama-server direct control run, same client and prompt
_source.n_params: llama-bench json model_n_params (the GGUF header of this file has no general.parameter_count)
